review.finding: serializeTable renders a cell only when textContent.trim() is non-empty; an image-only cell (| ![x](a.png) |) or hard-break-only cell is written empty, silently dropping the image.
review.suggestion: Test content.childCount > 0 instead; add round-trip case with an image in a cell.

review.finding: isGfmRepresentable ignores a hardBreak inside a cell paragraph (renderInline emits a newline that splits the row) and a non-paragraph single child (list).
review.suggestion: Require firstChild paragraph and no hardBreak descendants, else HTML fallback; add tests.

review.finding: Pipe escaping uses a negative lookbehind for a single backslash; when the text already holds a literal backslash before a pipe (escaped as two backslashes) the pipe stays unescaped and the cell splits.
review.suggestion: Escape when the preceding backslash run length is even; add a test with a backslash before a pipe.

review.finding: Image.configure({allowBase64:false}) makes TipTap's parseHTML drop img[src^=data:], so a data: URI image vanishes on save.
review.suggestion: Set allowBase64 true; add a test.

review.finding: Image src not validated; opening a file fetches any remote image (tracking beacon), inconsistent with the link allowlist.
review.suggestion: Document the decision or add an image-src allowlist.

review.finding: lib imports from components (MermaidCodeBlockView) while components import back from lib: reversed dependency direction.
review.suggestion: Inject the node view as a parameter or move the nodes file next to the components.

review.finding: Debounce timer + setState run for every code block on every keystroke, not only mermaid.
review.suggestion: Only mount the debounce in a child component for mermaid blocks.

review.finding: state.inTable never reset if renderInline throws; loose task list silently rewritten tight without a test.
review.suggestion: try/finally; add a test documenting loose->tight.

review.finding: setColumnAlign position math is correct; column lookup by index is wrong for colspan/rowspan tables (HTML fallback).
review.suggestion: Optional: disable align buttons for non-GFM tables.

review.finding: Coverage gaps: image-only cell, hardBreak in cell, backslash before pipe, data: image, loose task list, debounce proof.
